verdict.rationale: Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec at every standard path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The llms.txt index and per-endpoint llms/*.txt files are LLM-friendly prose and parameter listings, not a machine-readable API schema equivalent to OpenAPI. No evidence shows a downloadable API spec.
